raw:
I remember seeing the first ducklings on the park pond. There were five of them, following their mother. I was watching them, and the smallest one climbed onto a floating log. That’s the bit I remember best—this little duckling getting up onto the log while the others were there on the water.

It was such a small thing, but it made me happy. I was just enjoying watching them, not needing anything else to happen. When I think back to it, it’s that smallest one on the log that comes to mind first. I don’t remember who else was around; my attention was on the ducklings.
